When Hadhrat Umar (RA) heard what the deed contained, he took it from the two men, spat on it and thereby erased what was written on it. The two men were infuriated and addressed him with harsh words. Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ used to appease you (by granting you properties) at a time when Islaam was weak. Allaah has now strengthened Islaam (and there is no need to appease you), so you may go and do whatever you can against me. May Allaah offer you no protection even if you ask for it!" The two men stormed back to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) in a fury and said, "By Allaah! We do not know whether the Khalifah is yourself or Umar!" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "In fact he could have been the Khalifah if he chose to."
Hadhrat Umar (RA) then arrived in a rage and when he stood before Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), he asked, "Tell me about this land that you handed over to these two men. Does it belong to you or is it the public property of the Muslims?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "It is the public property of the Muslims." "Then why did you give it to these two men rather than anyone else from amongst the Muslims?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) demanded to know. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "I had consulted with these people around me and they indicated that I do so." Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Although you consulted with those around you, did you obtain the opinion and consent of every Muslim?" (Because it is not possible to seek the opinion of every person in every matter,) Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) (chose not to reply to Hadhrat Umar (RA) and rather) said, "I did tell you that you are more capable of Khilaafah than I am, but you overpowered me (and forced me to assume the task instead)." The Question of the Kharaaj from Bahrain

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Atiyya bin Bilaal and Hadhrat Sahm bin Minjaab
blocks.text: Hadhrat Atiyya bin Bilaal and Hadhrat Sahm bin Minjaab both narrate that Aqra and Zabarqaan approached Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and said, "Hand over to us the Kharaaj from Bahrain and we shall give you the guarantee that no one from our tribe will ever leave Islaam." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) acceded to the request and wrote a declaration to the effect. Amongst the witnesses appointed was Hadhrat Umar (RA). Since the agreement was facilitated by Hadhrat Talha bin Ubaydullaah (RA), it was he who brought the written agreement to Hadhrat Umar (RA). When Hadhrat Umar (RA) looked at it, he refused to be a witness and exclaimed, "There is no need to honour (appease) people anymore!" He then erased the content and tore it up. Hadhrat Talha (RA) became extremely angry and returned to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), saying, "Are you the Ameer or Umar?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "He is the Ameer although it is me who has to be obeyed."
